messages:
Asha: Starting onboarding for Nimbus Health (trial). Aim: search+chat pilot in 30 days. Posting owners + minimal checklist.

Ben: I'll take SSO certs and env access. Planning to request metadata today; will escalate if no response in 48h.

Diego: I'll own ingestion and field mapping. Need sample exports by EOD. If fields missing we'll add a mapping shim (adds ~2 days).

Marta: I'll run the enablement session Day 4 (30-45m). Target attendees: PM + infra + analytics. Will draft slides.

Asha: Compact checklist:
1) Day0: creds & billing (Asha)
2) Day1-4: ingest & mapping (Diego)
3) Day4: enablement (Marta)
4) Day5-12: SSO validation & smoke tests (Ben)
5) Day10-20: perf baseline & quotas (Ben/Diego)
6) Day14: NPS pulse (Asha)

ops-bot: Created calendar: "Nimbus Onboard - Weekly" Thurs 9:30 PT.

Asha: Success criteria snippet: "Activation = >=100 queries/day + 90th pct latency <800ms by Day30."

Diego: Note: schema gaps are medium risk. Will log expected dev-days in tracker if we need shims.

Ben: If SSO delayed >7d use token fallback for staging. Escalation: Day7->Director CS + Eng.

Asha: Please accept invites and update tracker with any blockers. Short updates in this thread only. :sparkles:
